# HR & Management Research Hub

> Academic resource hub for MBA, BBA, UGC NET HR aspirants, and research scholars in Human Resource Management. Focus on Ethical HRM and Quiet Quitting.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the academic platform.
- [About](/about): About the educator and the mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.
- [Blogs](/blogs): Articles on HR, management, and academic research.
- [Notes](/notes): Downloadable HRM, English, and exam-preparation notes.
- [Quizzes](/quizzes): Practice quizzes for MBA/BBA & UGC NET HR.
- [Books](/books): Curated book recommendations for HR students.
- [Newspaper Highlights](/newspaper): Daily news highlights for aspirants.
